ITEM 1 | Halved elongated fruit piece with pale yellow-green flesh and a darker green skin rim, glossy moist surface with slight sheen, smooth flesh with faint fibrous streaks, shape is a tapered wedge about 9 cm long and 3 cm wide at the widest, roughly 2 cm thick, lying on a white square plate in the upper left-center, no visible cooking marks | 75

ITEM 2 | Elongated half piece with pale yellow-green flesh and a dark green rind along one edge, slightly moist and smooth surface with a faint sheen, tapered oval shape about 8 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, roughly 2 cm thick, sitting on a white square plate to the right of item 1, no visible cooking marks | 60
